parameters.name: Comments
parameters.description:
The description.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the user group.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram create-group --group-name Dev-Team --comments Development_team --region cn-hangzhou
